about_the_game:
The Haunted Spot is a 2D Top-Down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a haunted hotel in order to experience the paranormal.

The B.E.H. hotel was built during the early 2000s and is said to be one of the most haunted places in the US. It is located just outside the main city area, which is often visited by the tourists and a few locals. However, this hotel has witnessed various tragic incidents in the past, which actually contributed to the rise in the paranormal activities. The hotel owner has received several complaints over the past 5 years from the customers as well as the staff of the hotel.

Many of them have witnessed several unexplained activities, dark apparitions, and spirits of the people who died here. Also, nobody dares to go to the basement after one of the hotel staff died there.

In 2008, one of the hotel waiters died mysteriously inside the hotel premises, and since then, his spirit has often been seen in the various rooms holding a knife. There have been reports of deaths in the past that resulted in the rise in paranormal activities. It has affected the business to some extent.

You play as a paranormal enthusiast called Jack, and your mission is to investigate the entire hotel premises in order to help out the hotel owner.

Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire hotel building!
  • Come face to face with the spirits!
  • Collect items like keys, black rituals book, pentagram amulet etc.
  • Explore the unknown spirit world.
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
